value.rationale: Shows a quantitatively sharp, positive, refinement-persistent mismatch in a motivated parameter used for calibrating numerical uncertainty; the exact λ^5/(exp(2λT)-1) spectrum identifies a nontrivial paired-rate matching resonance rather than treating any two unequal decay rates as necessarily mismatched. A constrained three-state benchmark is the smallest natural family with two dynamic modes and one common noise scale. The result guides whether a single scalar uncertainty knob can represent multiple modal discretization errors.
